description: This file defines the CSSDefinition class which specifies allowed CSS attributes and their valid values for HTML purification in the HTMLPurifier library.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_CSSDefinition
classes.description: A class that defines allowed CSS attributes and their values, used for sanitizing CSS in HTML documents.

methods.name: doSetup
methods.description: Initializes the info array with allowed CSS attribute definitions based on the provided configuration.

methods.name: doSetupProprietary
methods.description: Adds proprietary CSS properties for specific browsers like IE, if enabled in the configuration.

methods.name: doSetupTricky
methods.description: Adds additional CSS properties that are complex or tricky, such as display, visibility, and overflow.

methods.name: setupConfigStuff
methods.description: Configures allowed CSS properties based on external configuration, issuing warnings for unsupported properties.
